images.author: Nyttend
images.caption: Brick ranches on the western side of Lake Drive, north of McClain Road, in Bailey Lakes, Ohio, United States.

facade.notes: brick ranch with a one-car front-facing garage at one end, a screened porch at the other, chimney mid-ridge; driveway to the garage; mailbox post with the house number at the road edge; no sidewalk, no curb: lawns meet the asphalt; utility poles along the road; neighbours' ranches repeat the type

why.note: the car absorbed into the house: the attached garage becomes part of the ranch's facade after about 1955
brick veneer ranches: cheap masonry over frame, read as quality; common in Ohio tracts
rural subdivision without curbs or sidewalks: the mailbox and mown edge mark the front line
